member.summary: Ensures that the validation event handlers are attached to the masked edit control. If the handlers are already attached, this method performs no action.

member.name: T:DocxEditor.HexBinaryEvenLengthValidationRule
member.summary: Provides a validation rule that checks whether a hexadecimal binary string has an even number of characters.
member.remarks: This rule is typically used to ensure that input values representing hexadecimal binary data are valid for scenarios where each byte is represented by two hexadecimal characters. Whitespace in the input is ignored for the purpose of length validation. If the input is null or not a string, the validation passes by default.

member.name: M:DocxEditor.HexBinaryEvenLengthValidationRule.Validate(System.Object,System.Globalization.CultureInfo)
member.summary: Validates whether the specified value, after removing all spaces, has a length that is evenly divisible by two.
member.remarks: This method only applies validation logic to string values. All spaces are removed from the input before checking the length. Non-string values and null values are considered valid.
member.param: The value to validate. If the value is null or not a string, the validation succeeds by default.
The culture-specific information for the validation process. This parameter is not used in the current implementation.
member.returns: A ValidationResult that indicates whether the value is valid. Returns ValidationResult.ValidResult if the value is null, not a string, or has an even length after removing spaces; otherwise, returns a ValidationResult with an error message.

member.name: T:DocxEditor.HexBinaryValueConverter
member.summary: Converts HexBinary values to double and back for data binding scenarios in WPF.

member.name: M:DocxEditor.HexBinaryValueConverter.Convert(System.Object,System.Type,System.Object,System.Globalization.CultureInfo)
member.summary: Converts the specified value to its string representation using the specified target type and culture information.
member.remarks: This method returns null if the input value is null. The conversion is performed by calling the value's ToString method, and does not perform any type-specific formatting beyond what ToString provides.
member.param: The value to convert. If null, the method returns null.
The type to convert the value to. If a nullable type is specified, its underlying type is used.
An optional parameter that can be used to provide additional information for the conversion. This parameter is not used in the default implementation.
The culture information to use in the conversion process.
member.returns: A string representation of the value if the conversion is successful; otherwise, null if the input value is null.

member.name: M:DocxEditor.HexBinaryValueConverter.ConvertBack(System.Object,System.Type,System.Object,System.Globalization.CultureInfo)
member.summary: Converts a value that represents a hexadecimal string back to its corresponding strongly typed object, such as HexBinary, HexChar, HexInt, or HexLong.
member.remarks: If the input string is empty or contains only whitespace, the method returns Binding.DoNothing. The method also returns Binding.DoNothing if the input string does not meet the length requirements for the target type.
member.param: The value to convert, expected to be a string containing a hexadecimal representation.
The type to convert the value to. This can be HexBinary, HexChar, HexInt, HexLong, or a nullable version of these types.
An optional parameter that can specify the target type, which may override the targetType argument.
The culture information to use in the conversion. This parameter is not used.
member.returns: An object representing the converted value of the specified target type, or Binding.DoNothing if the conversion cannot be performed. Returns null if the input value is null.
member.exception: Thrown if the specified target type is not supported by the converter.
